import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    target = inputs["target_snapshot"].copy()
    cdc = inputs["cdc_events"].copy()

    # Map of device_id -> current applied_event_ts (watermark)
    watermark_map = target.set_index("device_id")["applied_event_ts"]

    # Attach current watermark to each cdc event
    cdc = cdc.merge(
        target[["device_id", "applied_event_ts"]],
        on="device_id",
        how="left",
        suffixes=("", "_watermark"),
    )

    # Determine which events survive:
    # - if device has no watermark (new device, NaT), event survives
    # - else event survives only if event_ts > applied_event_ts (strict)
    has_watermark = cdc["applied_event_ts"].notna()
    survives = (~has_watermark) | (cdc["event_ts"] > cdc["applied_event_ts"])

    surviving = cdc.loc[survives].copy()

    if not surviving.empty:
        # Pick winner per device: latest by (event_ts, event_seq)
        surviving = surviving.sort_values(
            by=["device_id", "event_ts", "event_seq"],
            ascending=[True, False, False],
        )
        winners = surviving.groupby("device_id", as_index=False).first()
        winners = winners[["device_id", "reading", "event_ts"]].rename(
            columns={"event_ts": "applied_event_ts"}
        )
    else:
        winners = pd.DataFrame(columns=["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"])

    updated_device_ids = set(winners["device_id"].tolist())

    # Carry forward devices from target_snapshot that did NOT get updated
    carried_forward = target[~target["device_id"].isin(updated_device_ids)].copy()
    carried_forward = carried_forward[["device_id", "reading", "applied_event_ts"]]

    # Combine carried forward + updated (winners may include new devices too)
    new_snapshot = pd.concat([carried_forward, winners], ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure proper dtypes
    new_snapshot["device_id"] = new_snapshot["device_id"].astype("int64")
    new_snapshot["reading"] = new_snapshot["reading"].astype("float64")
    new_snapshot["applied_event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(new_snapshot["applied_event_ts"]).astype("datetime64[us]")

    new_snapshot = new_snapshot.sort_values("device_id").reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"new_snapshot": new_snapshot}
